checksums.name: table_generation_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: sum1 = (Sum of (1+byte) for byte in record0[0:12]) mod M; sum2 = (Sum of running sum1) mod M; checksum = (sum1 << 16) | sum2; stored_value = seed + checksum, where seed = atoi-style decimal parse (FUN_080100ac) of an unidentified ROM string constant, and M = data constant _DAT_0800acf0 (not present in this workspace). Structurally identical to the Fletcher-16/Adler-32 checksum family. The modulus operation was verified bit-exact against Python a%b (FUN_080115c4).

io_driver_functions.notes: Generic unsigned 32-bit modulo (a % b), shift/subtract restoring division. Verified bit-exact in Python against 8 test vectors including divisor 65521 (Adler-32 modulus). Used by both the checksum routine and the generic atoi-style helper. Generic SDK/compiler runtime, not game-specific.
Raw DMA3 bit-stream transfer primitive used by both the EEPROM read and write paths; programs a DMA3 descriptor and busy-waits on the DMA status bit.

EEPROM single-8-byte-sector READ: issues a read-request+address bitstream, then reads back 64 bits via DMA3, storing 4 reconstructed halfwords at decreasing buffer addresses (reverse halfword order). Confirmed caller in decompiled.c: FUN_0800ac50 (0x0800ac50).
EEPROM single-8-byte-sector WRITE + busy-poll with timeout/tick accumulator. Call site found at decompiled.c:8000 but the calling function's address was outside the extracted seed window.
Referenced but NOT decompiled in this workspace. Inferred by call-pattern symmetry with 0x0801589c to be the EEPROM single-sector write entry point analogous to the read entry point. UNKNOWN body.
8-byte-chunk read loop wrapping FUN_0801589c over an arbitrary byte range.
8-byte-chunk write loop wrapping func_0x0801594c over an arbitrary byte range.
Bus-arbitration/IRQ+sound lock acquired before every EEPROM block transfer (disables 3 sound channel callbacks, snapshots a control word).
Restores the control word saved by 0x0800abc8.
ReadSaveBlock: full 512-byte EEPROM read into a RAM buffer, bracketed by the lock wrappers.
WriteSaveBlock: full 512-byte EEPROM write from a RAM buffer, bracketed by the lock wrappers. Always rewrites the entire image; no partial-sector commit path found.
Fletcher/Adler-style two-running-sum checksum over a caller-supplied length; called with length 0xC (12 bytes) covering record 0 only.
Generic atoi/strtol-style decimal string-to-integer parser; used to turn a ROM string constant into the checksum's additive seed. Generic libc-style routine, not game-specific.
